notes: Previous Drive CATALOG_50 'INTEGRATED' is a historical report, not a fresh runtime verification.
Candidate URLs are upstream project repositories or model cards; each needs a fresh version/license/security audit before download.
100 tools are choices, not 100 packages to install simultaneously.
Worms are logical roles and queues on existing NOX infrastructure, not self-replicating executables.

teacher_selection.principle: Teach missing validated skills, not raw model count. Keep one student NOX, one S03, frozen teachers.
inventory_first: Check existing model paths, hashes, owner-approved current training checkpoint and model identities
No redownload or duplicate copies for existing teacher
gates: Unique capability against CURRENT NOX and previously accepted teachers on source-separated holdout
Licensed and consented use of teacher outputs for distillation
Quality uplift, errors/regressions, RU/ES and task-success versus cost per useful accepted sample
Actual GPU memory and throughput tested on target VM
No production promotion before independent evaluation and owner acceptance

scheduler.max_parallel_teachers: min(available_isolated_gpu_slots, approved_budget); never assume 3-5 fit on one GPU

teacher_selection.deduplication: Compare response clusters, factual provenance, model-family correlations and existing S03; do not equate multiple same-family models with independent evidence
teacher_selection.checkpoint_policy: No automatic overwrite of active NOX weights; STOP fail closed; preserve snapshots and rollback
teacher_selection.note: This is a prioritization proposal, not proof these are the best performing models.
